topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I came home today to find a vase sitting just inside my door, filled with the most beautiful roses I've ever seen. The petals were almost too perfect, like they'd been painted. But there was no note, no clue as to who might have sent them. I picked up the vase, turning it over in my hands, checking for any hidden message or sign. The water was fresh, and the arrangement was too thoughtful to be a mistake. I set the vase down gently, trying to think of anyone who might do such a thing. It's a mystery, and I can't help but wonder what it means. Maybe it's nothing, or maybe it's the start of something new. I just wish I knew who to thank.
